subject: geometry
front: What does a point represent in elementary geometry?
back: An exact position, with no length, area or volume. Point is a primitive notion in an axiomatic treatment.
explanation: Assume ordinary Euclidean geometry; lengths and radii are nonnegative. Include the stated hypotheses when recalling the result.

source.note: Elementary reference card; not a claim of formal Lean verification.
